Name: Agent Deck
Description: Codex Micro-style control surface for Claude Code and Codex desktop apps: live agent status keys, accept/reject/new-chat command keys, one-tap workflow skills, and a reasoning-effort dial.
Author: Thomas Burgess

Actions.Name: Agent Status Key
Actions.Tooltip: Live status of an agent session (idle / working / needs input / done / error). Press to focus its window.

Actions.Name: Command Key
Actions.Tooltip: Accept, reject, interrupt, new chat, push-to-talk, or a custom command sent to the target app.

Actions.Name: Skill Key
Actions.Tooltip: Fire a preset workflow prompt (review PR, debug, refactor, ...) into the target app.

Actions.Name: Reasoning Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Cycle the reasoning effort of the target app (Claude effortLevel / Codex model_reasoning_effort).

Actions.Name: Target App Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Switch which app the other keys control: Claude Code or Codex.
